name: drone-builds
title: Drone Builds
description: Browse, restart and cancel your Drone CI builds, trigger cron jobs, and get native macOS notifications when builds finish — without leaving Raycast.
author: spicyfalafel

commands.name: menu
commands.title: Drone Build Notifier
commands.description: Background poller (every minute) that detects new build completions and fires native macOS notifications. Has no UI.

commands.name: builds
commands.title: Drone Builds
commands.description: Browse, restart and cancel your recent Drone builds

commands.name: restart-last
commands.title: Restart My Last Failed Build
commands.description: Find your most recent failed/errored Drone build and restart it (honors the mine/all filter)

commands.name: cancel-running
commands.title: Cancel My Latest Running Build
commands.description: Find your most recent running Drone build and cancel it (with confirmation, honors the mine/all filter)

commands.name: open-drone-server
commands.title: Open Drone Server
commands.description: Open the configured Drone server URL in the default browser

commands.name: run-cron
commands.title: Run Drone Cron Job
commands.description: Pick a repo and one of its cron jobs to trigger immediately (equivalent to POST /api/repos/{slug}/cron/{name})

preferences.name: droneUrl
preferences.title: Drone Server URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Drone server, e.g. https://drone.example.com

preferences.name: droneToken
preferences.title: Personal API Token
preferences.description: Bearer token from Drone user settings

preferences.name: filterMode
preferences.title: Notify About
preferences.description: Which builds to show and notify on

data.title: Only my builds (sender or commit author)

preferences.name: useTerminalNotifier
preferences.title: Notifier
preferences.description: Use terminal-notifier (brew install terminal-notifier) for clickable banners. Falls back to osascript if not found.
preferences.label: Use terminal-notifier when available

preferences.name: includeRepos
preferences.title: Include Repos
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of owner/repo slugs to include (e.g. acme/api,acme/web). Empty = include all.

preferences.name: excludeRepos
preferences.title: Exclude Repos
preferences.description: Comma-separated owner/repo slugs to skip even if they pass the mine/include filters.

preferences.name: demoMode
preferences.title: Demo Mode
preferences.description: Replace real repo slugs, authors, branches, commit messages and cron names with deterministic synthetic placeholders. Use when capturing screenshots — toggle off for normal use.
preferences.label: Redact sensitive data in UI (for screenshots)

preferences.name: longRunningMinutes
preferences.title: Long-Running Alert
preferences.description: Minutes a build can be running before firing a one-shot 'still running' notification. 0 disables.
